title: Emerging Hip-Hop group, Exile releases their recent track “Good Bye For Now”
htmlContent:
The fast-rising group, Exile, is an emerging hip-hop group from Quesnel, BC. The group consists of three talented individuals: Ryan Knutson (Explicit), Paul Heinzelman (Ill Logik), and Janelle Stoker. The group was founded in 2011. The two went from making music in a bedroom to investing their time and money into building a professional studio space.

Exile (CA), on their recent track “Goodbye For Now,” takes us through their journey and most profound thought in an authentic way that makes you listen, to take in the music, as you get swept up in the appeal of the music. The song is greatly inspired by the passing away of a loved one, and they go ahead to express their feelings in the most authentic way possible.
